mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal dysfunction; alpha lipoic acid may worsen mineral depletion through increased urinary excretion and reduce foscarnet clearance in compromised renal function.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium), renal function, and consider separating administration; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
